DEMURRER TO 1ST AMENDED COMPLAINT
Off Calendar Nov-06-2006 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: DEFENDANT DORIS MITCHELL-WOODS DBA CALIFORNIA COMBO MORTGAGE/DMW REALTY'S DEMURRER TO PLAINTIFF'S FIRST AMENDED COMPLAINT AND MOTION TO STRIKE (CCP SECTION 430.10(e), (f) and 435 et seq.).
APPEARANCE: Russell M. Davis, Esq. of Law Offices of Russell Davis 409-5627 for pltf & opposing party; Michael D. Maloney, Esq. of Sunderland McCutchan, LLP 707/284-5524 for deft & moving party.
RULING: Argued and the Court ruled as follows: Demurrer to the first, fourth, seventh and eighth causes of action overruled. Demurrer to the second cause of action sustained with leave to amend to only allege injunctive relief allegations. Demurrer to the fifth cause of action sustained with leave to amend to allege the terms of the alleged contract, plaintiff's performance or excuse for nonperformance, and the term or terms of that contract that were allegedly breached. Demurrer to the ninth cause of action sustained with leave to amend to allege, if plaintiff chooses, facts establishing plaintiff's right to relief under either or both the Truth in Lending Act and/or the Real Estate Settlement and Procedures Act. Motion to strike attorney's fees allegations granted with leave to amend to allege, if plaintiff chooses, entitlement to fees under either or both the Truth in Lending Act and/or the Real Estate Settlement and Procedures Act. Plaintiff may amend to request fees under CCP 1021.5. Plaintiff to prepare order. (301/HEK/PM) Judge: Harold E. Kahn, Reporter: LaVena Ward, CSR #7077
